oracles.tool: Pulumi's own loaders (workspace.LoadProject, pulumiyaml.LoadYAMLBytes and its interpolation parse) + an independent YAML reader for lines
oracles.version: pulumi-yaml v1.36.0, pulumi sdk v3.245.0, goccy/go-yaml v1.19.2

notes: definitions and references at tier A (wave ox, LB-Q-pulumi-yaml-rest; relabelled from the tier-C reference parse with the reason in calibration/oracles/pulumi-yaml-go/README.md, design §1.3 "the tool's own evaluation, the format's reference parser"): Pulumi's own loaders linked offline, the project loader the pulumi CLI runs (pulumi sdk v3.245.0 workspace.LoadProject: name, runtime, config) and the template parse and interpolation grammar the YAML language host runs (pulumi-yaml v1.36.0, the host pulumi CLI 3.247.0 ships: LoadYAMLBytes, its SymbolExpr and InterpolateExpr), each pulumi/templates file instantiated first by pulumi new's own workspace.CopyTemplateFiles (${PROJECT} mapped back to the name as written); lines from goccy/go-yaml v1.19.2, an independent reader: pulumi-yaml's YAML layer is gopkg.in/yaml.v3 like fathom's doc engine, while the program model and the interpolation grammar are Pulumi's (0 key lines disagree with pulumi-yaml's own ranges)
per-file times exclude the one-time grammar compile (an untimed warm-up extraction precedes timing)
